Theme

Computing & programming

backup noun

a copy of files

also back up, backup copy, make a backup

* our formation

Cic. Att. 4.5.1 (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 260, s.v. copy

* (our own formation) exemplar, exemplāris n.

noun, third declension

a copy: a backup

Our choice: no reference work has a word for a backup. Classically an exemplar is a copy of a letter or a book (Plin. Ep. 4.7.2: liber in exemplāria trānscrīptus mīlle), and Traupman gives it for a copy on a computer. To back up is exemplar servāre or facere (Traupman 260).

See also delete, document.

SourcesLewis & Short: exemplar

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 260.

No source has a word for a backup.
